title: API reference
subtitle: Point the OpenAI or Anthropic SDK at this gateway, or automate the console through /api. Test any listed path.
sdkTitle: {style, select, openai {OpenAI SDK} anthropic {Anthropic SDK} management {Management API} other {API}}
sdkDescription: {style, select, openai {Chat, Responses, embeddings, images, audio, files, and batches.} anthropic {Messages and token counting with native Anthropic requests and errors.} management {Keys, model aliases, providers, tenancy, budgets, usage, and logs.} other {Gateway endpoints.}}
auth: Authenticate with Authorization: Bearer and an API key from the console.
anthropicAuth: Use this origin as baseURL; the SDK adds /v1/messages. Send the same API key as x-api-key with anthropic-version: {version}. anthropic-beta passes through.
managementAuth: Send Authorization: Bearer with a management key (sk-mgmt-…) from <account>your account page</account>. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details.
curlTitle: {style, select, anthropic {Anthropic Messages} management {Management API} other {Chat completions}}
style: {style, select, openai {OpenAI} anthropic {Anthropic} dual {OpenAI and Anthropic} management {Management} other {Other}}
errorsHint: Every error has a stable code and an x-request-id header. Quote the request id when you report a problem.
errorShapeHint: {style, select, anthropic {Used on /v1/messages and on any /v1 request that sends anthropic-version.} management {Used on /api and console endpoints: application/problem+json (RFC 9457). The type links to the code below.} other {Used on the other /v1 endpoints. param names the offending field when known.}}
keysHint: Prefixes only. Full secrets are shown once when a key is created.
tryHint: {surface, select, management {Sends a live request to the management API with your management key.} other {Sends a live request to this gateway. Leave the key empty to send as your signed-in operator.}}
anthropicHeaders: Sends the key as x-api-key with anthropic-version: {version}.
apiKeyHint: {surface, select, management {Full management key. <keys>Create one on your account page</keys>.} other {Full secret. Prefixes on this page are not enough. <keys>Create an API key</keys> if you need one.}}
responseEmpty: Send a request to see the response.
tryError: {code, select, MISSING_PARAM {Fill every path parameter.} UNKNOWN_ENDPOINT {That path is not in the catalog.} INVALID_PATH {That path is not allowed.} INVALID_JSON {Body must be valid JSON.} UNAUTHORIZED {Sign in to use the console.} FORBIDDEN {You cannot send test requests with this role.} PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE {Request body is too large.} UPSTREAM_FAILED {The gateway did not respond.} MANAGEMENT_KEY_REQUIRED {Paste a management key (sk-mgmt-…) to call /api.} other {Request failed.}}
